subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart embeddings & reranking
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightcart.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart embeddings & reranking

Hi Alex / Ravi 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we're aligned and can move to next steps. High-level notes below 

Pain points and goals
- Current product search relevance has high false positives for short queries and synonyms (e.g., 'linen shirt' vs 'linen button-down').
- Want to reduce manual tuning and rule-based overrides; aim for more relevant personalized results.
- Success criteria: lift in NDCG@10 by 10-15% (measured on your eval set) and median search latency <= 75ms at peak.

Current stack
- Primary data store: Postgres for catalog + Redis for caching.
- Vector/embedding layer today: prototype using Pinecone (small index ~2M vectors) for product-level vectors; some teams experimenting with an in-house Faiss index for offline reranking.
- Embedding model: internal fine-tuned model (BGE-base variant) exported as 1536-d vectors.

Index scale & traffic patterns
- Estimated production index: 8-10M product vectors (product variants included).
- Query volume: peak QPS ~220 (search + personalization combined), baseline ~60 QPS.
- Batch patterns: nightly full re-embed (incremental upserts during the day, ~2-5k upserts/hour after catalog updates).

Latency / cost targets
- P50 search latency target: <=50ms (excluding client network). P95 target: <=120ms.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for predictable per-query unit economics; pilot should demonstrate cost of serving 1M queries/month.

Proposed pilot scope / next steps
1) Technical pilot (2-4 weeks): Redwood Dedicated pilot serving your reranking path for a subset of traffic (10-20%). Goal: validate latency targets with production-like index (~2-3M vectors) and measure cost/throughput.
2) Evaluation metrics: NDCG, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k queries, and upsert latency.
3) Timeline: kick off pilot tech call w/ Rafael (SE) this week; Rafael will propose a minimal infra config and data ingestion plan.
4) Security / procurement: happy to loop in our security docs if you need SOC2 evidence for the pilot.

Please confirm that I captured the main points and any missing pieces (e.g., retention requirements, redaction needs). If that looks right, Rafael and I can send a short tech plan and proposed pilot dates.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa - this is great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications / asks from our side: 

1) Index size - our 8-10M figure includes product variants; for the pilot we can scope a representative 2.5M slice (top categories + high-traffic SKUs).
2) Eval set - Ravi will send the NDCG baseline and the eval queries (we have ~15k labeled queries).
3) Security - we do need SOC2 evidence before provisioning any data for the pilot; can you share the SOC2 report or a link?

Immediate next steps: Rafael, can you propose a deployment configuration (GPU vs CPU, memory per pod, expected QPS per node) and estimate the infra cost for a 2-week pilot handling 2.5M vectors and 20% of traffic?

If that estimate looks reasonable, we'll finalize a mutual action plan and pick pilot start dates (aiming before mid-July).

Hi Alex / Ravi -

Appreciate the detail. Quick technical notes and a proposed pilot config to answer your Qs: 

Pilot scope suggestion (minimal viable)
- Index: 2.5M vectors (representative slice) stored in a Redis-Vector (vector index backed by Redis) or Pinecone managed index - either works for initial validation. For deterministic latency at scale we typically recommend a dedicated FAISS-based shard on GPU if you need tight p50s.
- Serving runtime: Redwood Dedicated - 1 GPU node (A100 or H100) with 2 worker replicas, autoscale to 3 during simulated peak. This config should handle ~250-300 QPS with p50 <= 40ms for k-NN + light rerank.
- Embedding compute: we can host the embedder as a sidecar or call your existing embedding endpoint; both supported. If you want to run embeddings in Redwood, we'd suggest a quantized BGE variant to reduce memory while keeping vector fidelity.

Data flow & upserts
- Nightly full re-embed (via S3 ingest) + streaming upserts for catalog changes. Upsert latency target: < 10s for single-item updates in the pilot.

Costs & estimate (very rough)
- Infra estimate for 2-week pilot (inc. a small infra buffer): $8-12k (node hours + storage + support). We'll provide a more detailed cost sheet once we lock on config and vector storage choice.

Next steps from my side
- I'll put together a short technical runbook (data ingestion, index format, benchmark harness) and share by EOD tomorrow.
- If you can share the eval set link and SOC2 doc (Marissa can provide), I'll schedule a 30-60m pilot kickoff to align on test harness and timelines.

Best -
Rafael Mendes
